subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw pursue this as a bundled dashboard bridge after the browser Canvas action-ingress contract lands, or route it outside core/dashboard for now?
rationale: The request crosses product direction and a security boundary: it depends on an unmerged dashboard widget host and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions through trusted Gateway/dashboard paths.

options.title: Defer Behind Canvas Ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement the dashboard bridge only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 defines the canonical browser action sink.

options.title: Design Dashboard Bridge Now
options.body: Sponsor a dashboard-first bridge spec now, accepting the risk of defining a second action path before the Canvas contract is settled.

options.title: Route Outside Bundled Dashboard
options.body: Decline bundled dashboard ownership and ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package once the necessary APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Defer Behind Canvas Ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement the dashboard bridge only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 defines the canonical browser action sink.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current bundled Control UI plugin-tab seam and is the strongest visible routing signal for dashboard/plugin-tab product direction.
